entities.summary: Germán Amed Rosario Valdez is a Dominican professional baseball utility player for the New York Yankees of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the New York Mets, Cleveland Indians/Guardians, Los Angeles Dodgers, Tampa Bay Rays, Cincinnati Reds, and Washington Nationals. He made his MLB debut in 2017 with the Mets.
